messages.subject: UT Austin Student Interested in Pursuing Banking @ Stifel NY
messages.body:
Hello Sean,

I hope you are doing well. I am an undergraduate Economics & Business student at the University of Texas, and I'm pursuing a career in Investment Banking. I'd love to talk to you to learn more about your experience at Stifel given I'm particularly interested in Banking in New York.

If you have any free time in the next week, it would be great to set up a quick phone call with you. I am pretty open and can likely adjust my schedule to accommodate whatever works best for you. Please let me know if you would be willing to do this. Attached is my resume.

Best,
Jonathan

messages.note: IMPORTANT FOR BOUNCE DETECTION. The machine-readable Status field says 4.4.2, which is a TEMPORARY failure class, while the SMTP response is 550 (permanent) and the human text says 'Address not found'. The three Aeris/Citi bounces in the gmail account all said Status: 5.1.1. A rule that keys on 'Status: 5.' would silently miss all three Stifel bounces.
